correctness.rationale: The normalized Szego kernel formula is exact. Schwarz–Pick isolates the range tip 1. A uniform polar Taylor expansion gives epsilon=(1-a)r²+o(r²) and imaginary part r^(m+1)Im(c exp(i(m-1)theta))+o(r^(m+1)). Extremizing fixed angles and the radial intermediate value theorem produce actual section points at both sharp bounds; the compactness of near-tip inverse images yields attained section extrema. The 29037 finite checks are confirmatory only.
